question: Which other classes of beings are included in this encompassing vision, O beloved?
premises: Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakshas, Nagas, and Vidyadharas are named.
These are diverse classes of non-human beings.
They are addressed in continuation of the prior enumeration.
inference: The vision also includes Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakshas, Nagas, and Vidyadharas.
plain_english: O beloved, Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakshas, Nagas, and Vidyadharas.
